decision: No automated service may replace, delete, or reinterpret the pre-existing notebook source set until its owner accepts an explicit source-lifecycle policy.
basis: The exact notebook predates this enterprise and may contain source relationships that are not represented on this settlement's plate.
The provider's currently proved mutation operation is replace-all-staged: it stages a complete desired set and then deletes every source named by the accepted prior observation.
Constituting the notebook as an enterprise establishes custody; it does not retroactively authorize destructive source replacement.

admissiblePolicyChoices.effect: Preserve admitted existing sources and add or retire sources only through explicit collection-level decisions; requires a provider operation finer than replace-all-staged.
Treat the notebook as a production workspace whose complete source set may be replaced by each admitted research packet.
Keep the notebook's source set unchanged and permit generation only from a successfully observed and admitted current state.

recommendedNextEvidence: Observe the current source IDs and titles without mutation, project that observation for owner review, and then accept one policy; observation still requires the provider's network capability and must not be represented as completed before it occurs.
